title: Project configuration — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of the project's `.pkit/capabilities/visual-communication/project/config.yaml` (DEC-002 point 2): the project's choices as a whole. `location` is the working folder that holds the project's libraries and pieces, recorded by the command that first writes there (COR-049 point 5); absent, the commands take `visual/` at the repository's top. `browser` names the browser the viewing step draws the HTML renderer's pages through, where the project wants another than the first it finds (DEC-020 point 7). `bar` is the bar the designer's loop runs to, and `bounds` the rounds it may run, beside the bar and no part of it (DEC-042 points 3 and 6). Never a look, a lock or a choice of one piece. Turning on plugins that reach a service comes later. Document-shaped schema: the file IS the resource. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:config`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

location.description: The location, a folder within the repository, relative to its top.

browser.description: The program of the browser the viewing step draws the HTML renderer's pages through, in place of the first browser of the Chromium family it finds (DEC-020 point 7): an absolute path, one that starts `~/` in the home folder, or one relative to the repository's top.

bar.description: The project's bar (DEC-042 point 3): the rules the review grades that it covers, and the grade each page and the piece must reach on them. A project keeps one bar. It asks no grade below `professional`, since a loop that met such a bar would end on a rule finding the designer could still mend. The capability's check fails a bar that covers what the review does not grade, and one whose major differs from the major the project pins for the set, or from the set's own where it pins none. The capability ships no bar.

covers.description: What the bar covers: rule sets by their ids, such as `COMM@2`, or single rules by theirs, such as `RS-COMM-003@2`, each with its set's major.

at-least.description: The grade each page and the piece must reach on the rules covered: `professional` or `excellent`. A grade below `professional` is refused.

bounds.description: The rounds the designer's loop may run (DEC-042 point 6), beside the bar and no part of it: `to-the-bar` the rounds it may run to the bar, `polish` the rounds of polish once it meets the bar. Whoever dispatches the designer may lower either for one run, and never raise it.

to-the-bar.description: The most rounds the loop runs to the bar.

polish.description: The most rounds of polish, once the verdict meets the bar.
